# MuiAD (full)

Self-hosted, MCP-first developer promotion network.
Site: https://muiad.meathill.com
Demo admin: https://admin.muiad.meathill.com
API / MCP: https://api.muiad.meathill.com
Repo: https://github.com/meathill/mui-ad
Short AI index: https://muiad.meathill.com/llms.txt
MCP discovery: https://muiad.meathill.com/.well-known/mcp.json

## Product summary

MuiAD lets indie developers and AI coding agents promote side projects without paying a traditional ad network. Each deployment is a node on Cloudflare (Workers + D1 + R2 + Workers AI). Nodes can later federate; today you can run a private island, join the public demo node, or self-host.

Design goal: finish promotion while you code. Talk to Claude / Cursor; the agent calls MCP tools to scan inventory, generate creatives, place ads, respect host approval modes, and optimize on CTR.

## MCP connection

1. Open https://admin.muiad.meathill.com (or your self-hosted admin).
2. Create an API key under `/api-keys` (`muiad_…`).
3. Register the Streamable HTTP MCP server:

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http muiad https://api.muiad.meathill.com/mcp \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer muiad_YOUR_KEY"
```

serverInfo (initialize): `{ "name": "muiad", "version": "0.1.0" }`
Auth: `Authorization: Bearer muiad_…` (per-user) or root `MUIAD_API_KEY` for ops/CI.

## MCP tools (13)

### Publisher (zone owner)

- `muiad_create_zone` — create an ad slot; fill category / description / tags / audience for better agent matching
- `muiad_list_zones` — list your zones
- `muiad_list_pending_attachments` — pending attach requests
- `muiad_review_attachment` — approve / reject

### Advertiser

- `muiad_register_product` — register a product to promote
- `muiad_upload_asset` — upload banner (base64 / data URL) to self-hosted R2; returns public `image_url`
- `muiad_scan_zones` — cross-user scan of active zones (category / tag filters)
- `muiad_create_ad` — create ad and attach to many zones; returns live / pending / skipped
- `muiad_list_ads` — list your ads
- `muiad_list_ads_performance` — full + per-zone metrics and attach status
- `muiad_set_ad_status` — pause / resume your ad

### Data

- `muiad_get_zone_stats` — zone impressions / clicks / CTR (unique visitors)
- `muiad_get_ad_conversions` — conversion summary for one ad

## Agent playbooks

### Advertiser auto-place

Prompt the agent to: register product → `muiad_scan_zones` → pick 3 matching zones → write zone-specific copy → `muiad_upload_asset` → `muiad_create_ad` → report live vs pending.

### Optimize loop

After a few days: `muiad_list_ads_performance` → pause CTR < 0.5% with enough impressions → highlight high-CTR zone expansions → remind on pending attaches older than 48h.

### Semi-auto approve (manual / ai modes)

`muiad_list_pending_attachments` → approve trusted categories → reject scam/deceptive notes → escalate the rest.

## Approval modes

Zone owners choose: `auto` | `manual` | `warm` | `ai` (Workers AI first pass, fail-closed).

## Embed / serve

Public ad serve JSON: `GET https://api.muiad.meathill.com/serve?zone=<zoneId>`
Landing demo zone is embedded on https://muiad.meathill.com (real impressions + click tracking).

## Auth model

| Call style | caller.user | Visibility |
|---|---|---|
| Admin session | current user | own data only |
| MCP + `muiad_…` | that user | own data only |
| MCP + `MUIAD_API_KEY` | null (root) | cross-user (ops/CI) |

Any authenticated advertiser may attach to any active zone; go-live depends on the zone owner's approval_mode. Stats and status changes are scoped to the caller.

## Roadmap

- Shipped: MVP-0 single instance + MCP + render; MVP-1 attribution; MVP-2 agent loop (scan / generate / review / optimize / marketplace)
- Next: MVP-3 node federation; MVP-4 traffic economy (credits / rev share / public nodes)
